---
title: "check-caller-permissions.yml"
---

Whole-tree, blocking check that a workflow calls each `Morrison-Lab/gha`
reusable workflow from a job that grants what the callee's jobs request.

A nested job cannot request more than its caller grants.
When a caller omits a permission, GitHub rejects the call at startup
(`startup_failure`) before any step runs, so the called workflow cannot warn,
and a scheduled caller stops with nothing but a failed run
(Morrison-Lab/lds#1468: the weekly preview cleanup lacked `actions: read`
and pruned nothing for a week).
This check runs in the consumer repository and fails the pull request instead.

For each `uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/<name>@<ref>` job, it fetches
that workflow at `<ref>` and takes the union of what its jobs request,
the same union `audit_callee_permissions.py` uses.
The caller's grant is the calling job's `permissions:` block, or the
workflow-level block when the job has none.
A call is reported as unchecked, with a warning, when the caller has no block
at either level (the grant is then the repository default, which the check
cannot see) or when a callee job has no block (what it needs is unknown).
Local `./` calls and other owners' workflows are not examined.
An unparsable workflow, an unreachable callee or an empty workflows directory
exits 2 instead of passing.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default               | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | --------------------- | ----------- |
| `workflows-dir` | string | `'.github/workflows'` | Directory holding the caller workflows. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`                | Fail the workflow when a caller lacks a required grant. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`              | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it. |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.
The callee is fetched anonymously from `raw.githubusercontent.com`, so the
runner needs outbound access to it.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-caller-permissions.yml in your repo.
name: Check caller permissions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-caller-permissions.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   workflows-dir: .github/workflows   # where the callers live
    #   fail: true                         # set false to warn only (defaults to true)
```

See
[`examples/check-caller-permissions.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-caller-permissions.yml)
for the full caller stub.
